criteria.extend_existing_packages: Grow the established process, files and codec packages with owner-scoped operations rather than opening a package. No registration changes; owner-mediated and direct Bun operations coexist per package, and the added members form the allowlist.
criteria.single_test_package: Open one package can.std.test@1 for the full base set (owner, workspace, process, evidence) with opaque handle types lacking constructors. Allowed native calls appear as individual catalogue operations, so the dispatch allowlist equals the new inventory and freeform dispatch/eval cannot be spelled. One emitter contribution routes identities to $canTest functions from the two new factories; forged ids miss the table and stale ids miss liveness.
criteria.split_owner_test_packages: Open can.std.owner@1 (grant identity, transport primitives) alongside can.std.test@1 (workspace, process, evidence). Two reserved packages, two factories, two emitter contributions split identity/transport from domain behavior.

binding_shape.instructions: Pick the option whose packaging and dispatch control best fits the acceptance clauses with minimal closed surface.
